card.fact_statement: Norina Tangaro-Casingal was appointed as a COMELEC commissioner ahead of the 2025 Philippine general election.
card.source_span: President Marcos appointed Norina Tangaro-Casingal, erstwhile director of the Commission on Elections law department as commissioner on February 10, 2025

target_qa_variants.question: Nani aliteuliwa kama kamishna wa COMELEC kabla ya uchaguzi mkuu wa Ufilipino wa 2025?

target_qa_variants.translation_note: Translated directly to Swahili, keeping proper nouns like COMELEC and the person's name intact.
